### The “Best” Sushi Restaurant in Los Angeles (as of 2026)

> **Sushi Gen** – *Koreatown / West Hollywood*

| Why it’s the top pick | Details |
|-----------------------|---------|
| **Authenticity** | Classic Edomae style, hand‑rolled nigiri, and a raw fish menu that rivals Tokyo’s best. |
| **Quality** | Uses only the freshest fish sourced from Japan and the West Coast. The chef’s daily “specials” showcase seasonal sashimi. |
| **Atmosphere** | Intimate, counter‑only setting that lets you watch the sushi master at work. |
| **Price** | $30–$45 for a 10‑piece omakase; great value for the quality. |
| **Location** | 1120 S. La Brea Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90028 (Koreatown). Easy to get to from most parts of LA. |
| **Reviews** | 4.8 ★ on Google, 4.7 ★ on Yelp, and featured in *Eater LA* and *Bon Appétit*. |

> **Pro tip:** Reserve a table in advance—Sushi Gen is a popular spot and often sells out, especially on weekends.

---

#### Other Notable Sushi Spots (for variety)

| Restaurant | Specialty | Price Range |
|------------|-----------|-------------|
| **Sushi Roku** (West Hollywood) | Fusion rolls & premium sashimi | $25–$55 |
| **Sushi Park** (West Hollywood) | Classic Edomae & creative rolls | $20–$50 |
| **Sushi Gen** (Koreatown) | Hand‑rolled nigiri & omakase | $30–$45 |
| **Sushi Tetsu** (Beverly Hills) | Traditional Edomae & omakase | $35–$60 |
| **Sushi Katsu** (Hollywood) | Fresh fish & affordable set menus | $15–$35 |

---

### How to Get There

- **By car:** 1120 S. La Brea Ave is on the 110 freeway; parking is available nearby (metered street or paid lots).
- **By public transit:** Take the Metro B Line to the La Brea station (Koreatown) and walk 5 minutes.
- **By rideshare:** A quick 10‑minute ride from most parts of LA.

Enjoy your sushi adventure! If you’d like a reservation link or more details on any of the other spots, just let me know.
